二维层流 Navier–Stokes 方程的离散伴随：格点格式

Discrete adjoints for 2D laminar Navier–Stokes: node-centred

从二维标量的同一张非结构混合网格出发，加入四个守恒量、完整黏性应力和热传导。逐步推导并执行原始、前向与伴随计算，检查物性、边界与坐标对目标的完整影响。面向学过微积分、线性代数和数值方法的读者，先研究无激波层流。

Start with the scalar lesson’s unstructured hybrid mesh and add four conserved quantities, full viscous stress and heat conduction. Derive and execute primal, tangent and adjoint computations, checking complete transport, boundary and coordinate effects on objectives. Calculus, linear algebra and numerical methods are the prerequisites; begin with shock-free laminar flow.

第 1 节Section 1

网格与守恒量

Mesh and conservative states

先选一个状态，再选相邻面。说明哪些值存储在网格上，哪些量要到面上计算。

Select one state and an adjacent face. Identify stored quantities and quantities evaluated at the face.

图 1.1：控制体收支Figure 1.1: Control-volume balance

从已经认识的二维网格出发

Start with the familiar two-dimensional mesh

本页沿用二维标量的混合 O 型网格：24 个原始节点、8 个四边形和 16 个三角形。一个标量现在换成四个守恒量；我们增加分子黏性、剪应力和热传导，不增加湍流模型。默认制造解用于检查方程与导数；另一个选项是有限外边界内的低速层流绕流。两者不是同一个边值问题。

The hybrid O-grid is the scalar lesson's mesh: 24 original vertices, eight quadrilaterals and sixteen triangles. Replace one scalar by four conserved quantities and add molecular viscosity, shear and heat conduction, without a turbulence model. The default manufactured case checks equations and derivatives; the other option is low-speed laminar flow in a truncated exterior domain. They are distinct boundary-value problems.

Ui=(ρi,mx,i,my,i,ei)T,Uh∈R4N,u=mxρ,v=myρ,T=e/ρ−(u2+v2)/2cv.U_i=(\rho_i,m_{x,i},m_{y,i},e_i)^T,\quad \mathbf U_h\in\mathbb R^{4N},\qquad u=\frac{m_x}{\rho},\quad v=\frac{m_y}{\rho},\quad T=\frac{e/\rho-(u^2+v^2)/2}{c_v}.

本页把 UiU_i 存在原始节点，围绕节点形成中位对偶控制体。基网格有 24 个控制体、80 个拓扑面、96 个状态自由度。一个内部对偶面可能弯折；必须分别计算每个子面的法向和两个 Gauss 求积点，再累加通量。

Store UiU_i at original vertices and construct median-dual volumes around them. The base mesh has 24 volumes, 80 topological faces and 96 state unknowns. An interior dual face can bend: evaluate each segment's normal and two Gauss points separately before accumulating flux.

nf=(Δy,−Δx)sf,sf=Δx2+Δy2,∑f⊂∂Visfnif=0.n_f=\frac{(\Delta y,-\Delta x)}{s_f},\quad s_f=\sqrt{\Delta x^2+\Delta y^2},\qquad\sum_{f\subset\partial V_i}s_fn_{if}=0.

面法向从左控制体指向右控制体，边界指向流体域外。面长 sfs_f 与单位法向分开存储，求积中只乘一次面长。点击或选择面可查看左右编号、梯度邻域及实际状态；颜色和数值均来自当前求解。数组和编号从 0 开始。

Normals point from left to right volumes, or out of the fluid domain at a boundary. Store length sfs_f separately from the unit normal and include length exactly once in quadrature. Select a face to inspect indices, reconstruction stencils and actual state values. All arrays and indices start at zero.

从“每单位体积”到“一个控制体内有多少”

From density to the amount inside a control volume

先把四个量的物理含义分开。ρ\rho 是质量密度，mx=ρu,my=ρvm_x=\rho u,m_y=\rho v 是两个动量密度，e=ρEe=\rho E 是总能量密度；这里 ee 不是比内能。理想气体的比总能量由比内能与比动能组成。先减去动能，再除以 cvc_v，才得到温度：

Separate the four physical quantities first. ρ\rho is mass density, mx=ρu,my=ρvm_x=\rho u,m_y=\rho v are momentum densities, and e=ρEe=\rho E is total energy per volume; ee is not specific internal energy. Subtract specific kinetic energy from specific total energy, then divide by cvc_v to recover temperature:

E=cvT+u2+v22,e=ρcvT+mx2+my22ρ,p=ρT=(γ−1)[e−mx2+my22ρ].E=c_vT+\frac{u^2+v^2}{2},\quad e=\rho c_vT+\frac{m_x^2+m_y^2}{2\rho},\quad p=\rho T=(\gamma-1)\left[e-\frac{m_x^2+m_y^2}{2\rho}\right].

本页采用单位厚度二维模型，因此控制体“体积”数值上等于平面面积。格心存储平均值时，控制体内四种总量就是 ViUiV_iU_i。格点版存储节点点值，围绕节点积分控制方程；不能把这个点值直接说成对偶体的精确平均值。

The planar model has unit depth, so volume equals area numerically. For stored cell averages, the four amounts in a cell are ViUiV_iU_i. The nodal scheme stores point values and integrates equations around a vertex; a nodal value is not the exact average over its dual volume.

Uicell=1Vi∫ViU(x,y) dA,Uinode≈U(Xi),Uh=(U0T,U1T,…,UN−1T)T.U_i^{\rm cell}=\frac1{V_i}\int_{V_i}U(x,y)\,dA,\qquad U_i^{\rm node}\approx U(X_i),\qquad \mathbf U_h=(U_0^T,U_1^T,\ldots,U_{N-1}^T)^T.

阅读后文时区分三种符号：U(x,y)U(x,y) 是介绍物理模型时的连续函数；UiU_i 是四分量存储向量；Uh\mathbf U_h 是长度 4N4N 的有限维列向量。速度分量 vv 与“前向方向向量”在前面的简记中同用字母；以下展开推导用 δUh\delta\mathbf U_h 或 ss 表示方向，避免把它当作 y 方向速度。参数记为 aa，压力仍记为 pp。

Distinguish the continuous field U(x,y)U(x,y), the four-component stored vector UiU_i, and the length-4N4N column Uh\mathbf U_h. Earlier formulas use v both for transverse velocity and a tangent direction; expanded derivations below use δUh\delta\mathbf U_h or ss for directions. Parameters are aa, whereas pressure is pp.

通量、重构与黏性梯度

Fluxes, reconstruction and viscous gradients

选择内部面，依次查看两个求积点。先核对左右迹，再核对应力和净通量。

Select an interior face and visit both Gauss points. Check traces, stress and net flux in that order.

图 2.1：面上的应力与热流Figure 2.1: Stress and heat on a face · 图 2.2：重构与两侧迹Figure 2.2: Reconstruction and traces

物理张量怎样成为面上的四分量通量

From physical tensors to a four-component face flux

采用无量纲气体常数 1，γ=1.4,cv=2.5,cp=3.5\gamma=1.4,c_v=2.5,c_p=3.5。压力 p=ρTp=\rho T。上标 c、v 分别代表对流和黏性，不能把黏性应力当成四个互不相关的标量扩散项。

Use nondimensional gas constant one and γ=1.4,cv=2.5,cp=3.5\gamma=1.4,c_v=2.5,c_p=3.5, with p=ρTp=\rho T. Superscripts c and v denote convection and viscosity. Viscous stress is not four independent scalar diffusion terms.

un=unx+vny,Fnc=[ρunmxun+pnxmyun+pny(e+p)un],Fnv=[0(τn)x(τn)y(u,v)⋅τn−qn].u_n=un_x+vn_y,\quad F_n^c=\begin{bmatrix}\rho u_n\\m_xu_n+pn_x\\m_yu_n+pn_y\\(e+p)u_n\end{bmatrix},\quad F_n^v=\begin{bmatrix}0\\(\tau n)_x\\(\tau n)_y\\(u,v)\cdot\tau n-q_n\end{bmatrix}.
df=Gxu+Gyv,τxx=μ(2Gxu−23df),τyy=μ(2Gyv−23df),τxy=μ(Gyu+Gxv),qn=−κGT⋅n.d_f=G_x^u+G_y^v,\quad\tau_{xx}=\mu(2G_x^u-\tfrac23d_f),\quad\tau_{yy}=\mu(2G_y^v-\tfrac23d_f),\quad\tau_{xy}=\mu(G_y^u+G_x^v),\quad q_n=-\kappa G^T\cdot n.
μ=μreforμ=μref1.4T3/2T+0.4,κ=cpμPr.\mu=\mu_{\rm ref}\quad\text{or}\quad \mu=\mu_{\rm ref}\frac{1.4T^{3/2}}{T+0.4},\qquad\kappa=\frac{c_p\mu}{Pr}.

这里 GG 专指下面定义的离散梯度；2/32/3 来自三维 Newton 应力在平面二维运动下的限制。黏性功与热流都进入能量方程。面上的总通量为对流减黏性，热流在总能量通量中以正号出现。

Here GG denotes the discrete gradients defined below. The factor 2/32/3 restricts three-dimensional Newtonian stress to plane motion. Both viscous work and heat enter energy. Net flux is convection minus viscosity, so heat enters net energy with a plus sign.

展开守恒通量：质量、力和功率

Expand the flux: mass, force and power

质量穿过单位面积面的速率是 ρun\rho u_n；它携带的 x、y 动量分别乘以 u,vu,v。压力又在面上施加法向力 pnpn，压力功率为 punp u_n。因此能量对流项不是单独的 eune u_n，而是 (e+p)un(e+p)u_n。黏性应力做功为 (u,v)⋅τn(u,v)\cdot\tau n，导热携带能量而不携带质量。这分别给出上面的四行通量。

Mass crosses unit face area at rate ρun\rho u_n, carrying x/y momentum at that rate times u,vu,v. Pressure contributes normal force pnpn and power punpu_n, giving energy convection (e+p)un(e+p)u_n. Viscous traction does work (u,v)⋅τn(u,v)\cdot\tau n; heat transports energy but no mass. These observations produce the four flux rows above.

τ=μ[43ux−23vyuy+vxuy+vx43vy−23ux],τn=[τxxnx+τxynyτxynx+τyyny].\tau=\mu\begin{bmatrix}\frac43u_x-\frac23v_y&u_y+v_x\\u_y+v_x&\frac43v_y-\frac23u_x\end{bmatrix},\quad \tau n=\begin{bmatrix}\tau_{xx}n_x+\tau_{xy}n_y\\\tau_{xy}n_x+\tau_{yy}n_y\end{bmatrix}.

这里的 uxu_x 等只在物理模型介绍中表示空间导数。代码会用下文重构产生的 GxuG_x^u 等替代它们。平面运动仍是三维流体本构的限制：w=0,∂z=0w=0,\partial_z=0，但通常 τzz=−(2/3)μ(ux+vy)\tau_{zz}=-(2/3)\mu(u_x+v_y) 不为零。这解释了系数为何是 2/32/3，而不是把空间维数改成二就改成另一系数。

Here uxu_x denotes a spatial derivative in the physical model; code replaces it by reconstructed GxuG_x^u. Plane motion restricts a three-dimensional constitutive law: w=0,∂z=0w=0,\partial_z=0, but generally τzz=−(2/3)μ(ux+vy)≠0\tau_{zz}=-(2/3)\mu(u_x+v_y)\ne0. This explains the factor 2/32/3.

同时保留平均值与几何矩

Retain averages and geometric moments

Pi(x)=Ui+cx,iξ+cy,iη+cxx,i(ξ2−Mxx,i)+cxy,i(ξη−Mxy,i)+cyy,i(η2−Myy,i),(ξ,η)=x−xi.P_i(x)=U_i+c_{x,i}\xi+c_{y,i}\eta+c_{xx,i}(\xi^2-M_{xx,i})+c_{xy,i}(\xi\eta-M_{xy,i})+c_{yy,i}(\eta^2-M_{yy,i}),\quad (\xi,\eta)=x-x_i.

格点系数采用 Mxx=Mxy=Myy=0M_{xx}=M_{xy}=M_{yy}=0，因为存储数据是点值。

For node values set Mxx=Mxy=Myy=0M_{xx}=M_{xy}=M_{yy}=0 because stored data are point values.

min⁡ci∑j∈Niωij∥bijci−(Uj−Ui)∥2,ωij=∥xj−xi∥−2,Hici=ri.\min_{c_i}\sum_{j\in\mathcal N_i}\omega_{ij}\|b_{ij}c_i-(U_j-U_i)\|^2,\quad\omega_{ij}=\|x_j-x_i\|^{-2},\quad H_ic_i=r_i.

邻域沿连通图扩展，至少收集足够数据拟合五个非恒定系数；四个守恒分量共享同一几何矩阵。二次多项式用于黏性迹和梯度。对流一阶使用存储状态，二阶使用 Ui+cx,iξ+cy,iηU_i+c_{x,i}\xi+c_{y,i}\eta；无 limiter。对流耗散速度固定为 3，不对状态取 max 或绝对值。其适用范围由正值与波速诊断约束。

Expand graph neighbours to fit five nonconstant coefficients; four conserved components share the geometric matrix. Quadratic polynomials provide viscous traces and gradients. First-order convection uses stored states, while second order uses Ui+cx,iξ+cy,iηU_i+c_{x,i}\xi+c_{y,i}\eta. No limiter is applied. Convective dissipation speed is fixed at 3, without state-dependent max or absolute value; positivity and wave-speed diagnostics delimit its use.

F^nc=12(Fnc(U−)+Fnc(U+))−32(U+−U−).\widehat F_n^c=\tfrac12(F_n^c(U^-)+F_n^c(U^+))-\tfrac32(U^+-U^-).

最小二乘正规方程怎样得到

Deriving the least-squares normal equations

先只看一个守恒分量 zz，例如密度。令五个未知系数排成列 cic_i，邻居中心相对位置为 (Δx,Δy)(\Delta x,\Delta y)。因为 zjz_j 是平均值，格心的拟合行还必须包含邻居和本单元的中心矩：

Consider one conserved component zz, such as density. Stack its five coefficients into cic_i and let (Δx,Δy)(\Delta x,\Delta y) be the neighbour-centre offset. Cell-average fitting must include both cells’ central moments:

bij=[Δx,Δy,Δx2+Mxx,j−Mxx,i,ΔxΔy+Mxy,j−Mxy,i,Δy2+Myy,j−Myy,i].b_{ij}=\left[\Delta x,\Delta y,\Delta x^2+M_{xx,j}-M_{xx,i},\Delta x\Delta y+M_{xy,j}-M_{xy,i},\Delta y^2+M_{yy,j}-M_{yy,i}\right].

格点版本令全部中心矩为零。把所有 bijb_{ij} 叠成矩阵 BiB_i，把 zj−ziz_j-z_i 叠成 did_i，权重构成对角矩阵 WiW_i。最小化的是“邻居数据与多项式预测不一致”的加权平方和：

For nodes all central moments are zero. Stack rows bijb_{ij} into BiB_i, differences zj−ziz_j-z_i into did_i, and weights into diagonal WiW_i. Minimize the weighted squared mismatch between data and polynomial predictions:

Φ(ci)=12(Bici−di)TWi(Bici−di).\Phi(c_i)=\frac12(B_ic_i-d_i)^TW_i(B_ic_i-d_i).
δΦ=(Bici−di)TWiBiδci,∇ciΦ=BiTWi(Bici−di)=0.\delta\Phi=(B_ic_i-d_i)^TW_iB_i\delta c_i,\quad \nabla_{c_i}\Phi=B_i^TW_i(B_ic_i-d_i)=0.
BiTWiBi⏟Hici=BiTWidi⏟ri,ci=Hi−1ri.\underbrace{B_i^TW_iB_i}_{H_i}c_i=\underbrace{B_i^TW_id_i}_{r_i},\qquad c_i=H_i^{-1}r_i.

这是一个 5×55\times5 系统，每个守恒分量各解一次，几何矩阵可以共享。邻居数量多于五仍不保证可解，还要有足够独立的几何方向。实现检查权重的有限性和二次多项式再现误差；这里写逆矩阵是为了说明关系，不要求读者把“大矩阵显式求逆”当作求解原则。拟合矩阵 HiH_i 与面通量 HfH_f 由下标和维度区分。

This is a 5×55\times5 system for each conserved component, sharing geometry. More than five neighbours is insufficient without independent geometric directions. The implementation checks finite weights and quadratic reproduction. Inverse notation expresses the relation, not a recommendation to explicitly invert large matrices. Fit matrix HiH_i and face-flux vector HfH_f differ in indices and dimensions.

ci=(cx,i,cy,i,cxx,i,cxy,i,cyy,i)T,∂xPi=cx,i+2cxx,iξ+cxy,iη,∂yPi=cy,i+cxy,iξ+2cyy,iη.c_i=(c_{x,i},c_{y,i},c_{xx,i},c_{xy,i},c_{yy,i})^T,\quad\partial_xP_i=c_{x,i}+2c_{xx,i}\xi+c_{xy,i}\eta,\quad\partial_yP_i=c_{y,i}+c_{xy,i}\xi+2c_{yy,i}\eta.

黏性迹、梯度与跳跃修正

Viscous traces, gradients and jump correction

Ufv=12(PL(xf)+PR(xf)),Gfθ=12(∇θ(PL)+∇θ(PR))+2θ(PR)−θ(PL)d⋅dd,d=xR−xL.U_f^v=\tfrac12(P_L(x_f)+P_R(x_f)),\quad G_f^\theta=\tfrac12(\nabla\theta(P_L)+\nabla\theta(P_R))+2\frac{\theta(P_R)-\theta(P_L)}{d\cdot d}d,\quad d=x_R-x_L.

θ∈{u,v,T}\theta\in\{u,v,T\}。先对守恒多项式求空间梯度，再用原始变量转换的 Jacobian 得到各侧原始量梯度。跳跃修正使用同一面点的两侧迹，系数为 2；它不是第 1D 页的中心点差分。精确二次守恒多项式的左右迹一致，修正为零。非线性转换、边界和通量装配后的整体阶数仍需制造解测量。

For θ∈{u,v,T}\theta\in\{u,v,T\}, differentiate the conservative polynomial spatially, then apply the primitive-conversion Jacobian. The penalty uses both traces at the same face point with coefficient two; it is not the 1D centre difference. Exact quadratic conservative traces agree and have zero penalty. Nonlinear conversion, boundaries and flux assembly still require measured global convergence.

守恒量梯度怎样转换成速度、温度梯度

Converting conserved gradients to velocity and temperature gradients

对 u=mx/ρu=m_x/\rho 使用商法则，再对总能量关系使用链式法则。若 gαzg_\alpha^z 表示重构守恒分量 zz 的空间斜率，α=x,y\alpha=x,y，实际计算为：

Apply the quotient rule to u=mx/ρu=m_x/\rho and the chain rule to total energy. With gαzg_\alpha^z the reconstructed slope of conserved component zz and α=x,y\alpha=x,y, code evaluates:

Gαu=gαmx−ugαρρ,Gαv=gαmy−vgαρρ,G_\alpha^u=\frac{g_\alpha^{m_x}-u g_\alpha^\rho}{\rho},\quad G_\alpha^v=\frac{g_\alpha^{m_y}-v g_\alpha^\rho}{\rho},
GαT=1cv[gαe−(e/ρ)gαρρ−uGαu−vGαv].G_\alpha^T=\frac1{c_v}\left[\frac{g_\alpha^e-(e/\rho)g_\alpha^\rho}{\rho}-uG_\alpha^u-vG_\alpha^v\right].

不要用“分别拟合速度和温度”替代这条链：它会定义另一种离散残差。本页先拟合守恒量，再进行上述非线性转换。二阶对流仅取多项式的常数与线性部分，黏性仍使用完整二次迹及其梯度；空间精度按钮不是将所有多项式统一切成同一次数。

Fitting velocity and temperature independently would define a different residual. This implementation reconstructs conserved variables and then converts them nonlinearly. Second-order convection keeps only the constant and linear terms, while viscosity retains quadratic traces and gradients.

第 3 节Section 3

完整边界闭合

Complete boundary closures

分别选择入流和牵引出口。切换到绕流后，再比较等温与绝热壁面；每次先重新计算。

Compare inflow and traction outflow. In the physical-flow case, recompute and compare isothermal and adiabatic walls.

图 3.1：两类热学边界Figure 3.1: Thermal boundary conditions

先定义边界函数，再对边界函数求导

Define a boundary function before differentiating it

制造解在内外边界按固定入流／出流分区提供数据；它的内圈不是固壁。绕流算例的内圈才是静止无滑移壁。分区由基网格面法向与固定方向 (0.22,0.055)(0.22,0.055) 的点积决定，求导时保持不变；参数或几何扰动越过支持范围需要报告，不能默默切换分支。

Manufactured data use fixed inflow/outflow partitions on both boundaries; the inner boundary is not a solid wall in that case. Only the flow case has a stationary no-slip inner wall. The base normal dotted with fixed direction (0.22,0.055)(0.22,0.055) sets the partition, held fixed during differentiation. Perturbations outside the supported branch must be reported, not silently switched.

Gbθ=∇θ(PL)+2(θb−θ(PL))δbn,δb={(xb−xL)⋅ncell,VLnode.G_b^\theta=\nabla\theta(P_L)+\frac{2(\theta_b-\theta(P_L))}{\delta_b}n,\qquad \delta_b=\begin{cases}(x_b-x_L)\cdot n&\text{cell},\\\sqrt{V_L}&\text{node}.\end{cases}

入口给定密度、两个速度和温度。对流使用规定状态的物理通量；速度、温度的黏性梯度使用上式弱边界修正。几何距离和边界数据都要参与求导。这里没有把同一模板无条件宣称为任意网格上的二阶壁面应力。

Inflow prescribes density, both velocities and temperature. Convection uses the prescribed physical flux, while viscous gradients of velocity and temperature receive the weak boundary correction above. Geometry distances and prescribed data are differentiated. This stencil is not unconditionally advertised as second-order wall stress on arbitrary meshes.

出口采用总牵引与热流

Outflow specifies total traction and heat flux

tb=pn−τn,Hb=[ρunρuun+tb,xρvun+tb,yeun+(u,v)⋅tb+qb].t_b=pn-\tau n,\quad H_b=\begin{bmatrix}\rho u_n\\\rho u u_n+t_{b,x}\\\rho v u_n+t_{b,y}\\e u_n+(u,v)\cdot t_b+q_b\end{bmatrix}.

绕流外出口取 tb=n,qb=0t_b=n,q_b=0；制造解取解析场的总牵引和热流。出口通量中的压力与应力已按条件消去，不能再叠加一次内部黏性通量。它是有限截断域的边界闭合，不是未经证明的无限远条件。

Flow outflow uses tb=n,qb=0t_b=n,q_b=0; manufactured outflow uses analytic traction and heat flux. Pressure and stress have already been eliminated in this net boundary flux: do not subtract an interior viscous flux again. This defines a truncated-domain closure, not a proven infinite-far-field condition.

固壁的机械与热学条件

Mechanical and thermal wall conditions

ub=vb=0,Tb=Tw or qb=0,Hb,ρ=0,Hb,E=qb.u_b=v_b=0,\qquad T_b=T_w\ \text{or}\ q_b=0,\qquad H_{b,\rho}=0,\quad H_{b,E}=q_b.

等温壁把壁温送入物性和梯度修正；绝热壁显式令法向热流为零。壁面密度从内部二次迹外推，压力由该密度和面温度得到。因为壁面速度为零，黏性功在壁面净能量通量中为零。

An isothermal wall sends wall temperature into transport and gradient correction; an adiabatic wall sets normal heat flux to zero. Extrapolate density from the interior quadratic trace and form pressure with face temperature. Zero wall velocity eliminates wall viscous work from net energy flux.

格点版最后强制覆盖固壁的两个速度行；等温时以温度差覆盖能量行；绝热时则以节点重构温度梯度的零法向热流覆盖能量行。密度平衡行保留。节点法向取相邻壁面半面的长度加权法向之和再归一化，在多边形角点这是明确选择的离散闭合，并非唯一连续法向。纯入流节点覆盖密度、两个速度和温度四行，纯出流节点保留自然通量行。同一节点同时连接入流和出流半面时，只覆盖密度与两个速度行，能量行保留所有半面通量减体热源的积分平衡；入口温度仍通过入口半面的规定状态和黏性梯度修正施加，出口半面仍使用牵引与热流数据。不能把这个混合控制体的能量行整体替换为入口温度差。多个边界半面共用节点时，固壁约束优先于入流约束。这些覆盖都属于离散函数，反向必须先屏蔽旧平衡行。被覆盖的原始动量／能量平衡并不一定为零；下表“原始平衡之和＝边界净通量减源项”是装配恒等式，不能将它误读为所有原始控制体平衡均已收敛。

Nodes overwrite both velocity rows at walls. The energy row becomes a temperature difference for isothermal walls or zero normal heat flux from the reconstructed nodal temperature gradient for adiabatic walls; the density balance remains. Normalize the sum of neighbouring wall-half-face length normals to define the nodal normal. At polygon corners this is a specified discrete closure, not a unique continuum normal. Pure inflow nodes overwrite density, both velocities and temperature; pure outflow keeps natural flux rows. At an inlet/outlet junction, overwrite only density and both velocity rows, retaining the energy balance of all half-face fluxes minus the volume source. Inlet temperature remains imposed by the prescribed inlet state and viscous-gradient correction; outlet half-faces retain traction and heat-flux data. Do not replace this mixed control volume’s energy balance with an inlet-temperature difference. Wall constraints take precedence at shared boundary nodes. Overwrites belong to the discrete function and reverse propagation must mask old balances first. Replaced raw momentum/energy balances need not vanish. The table identity “sum of raw balances = net boundary flux minus sources” verifies assembly, not convergence of every original balance.

Ri,E={Ti−Twisothermal,−κ(Ti) GiT⋅niadiabatic,ni=∑f∋i, f⊂Γwsfnf∥∑f∋i, f⊂Γwsfnf∥.R_{i,E}=\begin{cases}T_i-T_w&\text{isothermal},\\-\kappa(T_i)\,G_i^T\cdot n_i&\text{adiabatic},\end{cases}\quad n_i=\frac{\sum_{f\ni i,\ f\subset\Gamma_w}s_fn_f}{\left\|\sum_{f\ni i,\ f\subset\Gamma_w}s_fn_f\right\|}.

交界节点：温度条件按半面施加

Junction nodes: impose temperature data per half-face

以实际节点 2 的对偶控制体为例：它连接一个入口半面和一个出口半面。蓝色入口半面继续使用给定状态和温度修正；橙色出口半面继续使用总牵引与热流。保留两者共同参与的能量平衡，让热源扰动能通过这个控制体传递。这个规则按拓扑自动判断，不依赖节点编号。

The actual dual volume at node 2 touches an inlet half-face and an outlet half-face. The blue inlet retains its prescribed state and temperature correction; the orange outlet retains total traction and heat flux. Keep the energy balance involving both, so a heating perturbation can act through this volume. Classification is topological, not tied to node IDs.

Ri,E={Ti−Tb,pure inlet,∑fσifHf,E−Si,E,inlet/outlet junction.R_{i,E}=\begin{cases}T_i-T_b,&\text{pure inlet},\\\displaystyle\sum_f\sigma_{if}H_{f,E}-S_{i,E},&\text{inlet/outlet junction}.\end{cases}

这里不是取消入口温度：入口半面的 TbT_b 仍进入规定状态、物性与黏性梯度修正。只是避免将含出口半面的整个能量控制体替换为单个温度条件。物理固壁仍优先使用原有等温／绝热条件；制造解内圈的开口边界不能按物理固壁处理。

Inlet temperature has not been removed: T_b still enters the prescribed inlet state, transport and viscous-gradient correction. The change avoids replacing an energy volume that also touches outflow by one temperature constraint. Physical walls retain priority and their existing isothermal/adiabatic conditions; the open manufactured inner boundary is not a physical wall.

R˙i,E=∑fσifH˙f,E−S˙i,E,Ra,i,E∣X fixed=−∫Ωis dΩ.\dot R_{i,E}=\sum_f\sigma_{if}\dot H_{f,E}-\dot S_{i,E},\qquad \left.R_{a,i,E}\right|_{X\ \text{fixed}}=-\int_{\Omega_i}s\,d\Omega.

对热源幅度求导时，交界能量行必须包含体源方向；纯入口温度行则对该参数没有显式导数。前向使用以上能量方向导数。反向先传播密度与速度约束，再将能量种子保留给通量和源项，不能将四个分量全部清零。

For heating amplitude, junction energy rows must retain the source direction, while pure-inlet temperature rows have no direct derivative with respect to heating. Tangent propagation uses the energy variation above. Reverse propagation first handles density/velocity constraints, then retains the energy seed for fluxes and sources rather than zeroing all four components.

Mi=diag⁡(0,0,0,1),wˉi=Miwi,ga=ja+Ra,hTψh.M_i=\operatorname{diag}(0,0,0,1),\qquad \bar w_i=M_iw_i,\qquad g_a=j_a+R_{a,h}^{T}\psi_h.

The boundary demo below identifies each row as a strong condition or flux-minus-source balance and shows residuals before and after replacement. Appendix A.18 recomputes refinement with this same implementation. FD agreement verifies the discrete derivative; approach to the continuous reference still requires independent mesh comparison.

把边界条件代入通量，而不只是写在图上

Substitute boundary data into the actual flux

出口给定的是总牵引 tb=pn−τnt_b=pn-\tau n，不是同时各自给定压力和所有速度导数。将这个等式代入动量通量，pn−τnpn-\tau n 就整体替换为 tbt_b；能量中同样合并压力功与黏性功：

Outflow specifies total traction tb=pn−τnt_b=pn-\tau n, not pressure and all velocity derivatives independently. Substitute it into momentum flux. Combine pressure and viscous work in energy in the same way:

(e+p)un−(u,v)⋅τn+qn=eun+(u,v)⋅(pn−τn)+qn=eun+(u,v)⋅tb+qb.(e+p)u_n-(u,v)\cdot\tau n+q_n=e u_n+(u,v)\cdot(pn-\tau n)+q_n=e u_n+(u,v)\cdot t_b+q_b.

固壁处速度为零，所以质量通量为零、压力功为零、黏性功也为零，只剩法向导热通量进入能量收支。等温边界规定温度值；绝热边界规定法向热流。两者不是同时施加的两个条件。

At a stationary no-slip wall, mass flux, pressure work and viscous work vanish, leaving normal heat in the energy balance. Isothermal data specify temperature; adiabatic data specify normal heat flux. They are alternative conditions.

以一个原始变量 θ\theta 为例，弱梯度修正中的距离、法向、内侧迹和边界值都可能变化。把 Δθ=θb−θL\Delta\theta=\theta_b-\theta_L 记清楚，就可以用乘积与商法则逐项求导：

For one primitive variable θ\theta, boundary distance, normal, interior trace and prescribed value may all vary. Writing Δθ=θb−θL\Delta\theta=\theta_b-\theta_L, product and quotient rules give every term:

δGbθ=δGLθ+2(δθb−δθL)δbn−2Δθδb2(δδb)n+2Δθδbδn.\delta G_b^\theta=\delta G_L^\theta+\frac{2(\delta\theta_b-\delta\theta_L)}{\delta_b}n-\frac{2\Delta\theta}{\delta_b^2}(\delta\delta_b)n+\frac{2\Delta\theta}{\delta_b}\delta n.

上式的 δb\delta_b 是边界距离，δδb\delta\delta_b 是这个距离的变化。系数 2 是本离散闭合选定的惩罚强度，不是由边界条件本身唯一推出来的常数。若是规定不变的壁温，其状态方向导数为零，但“对壁温参数求导”时 δTb\delta T_b 不为零。

Here δb\delta_b is distance and δδb\delta\delta_b its variation. The factor two is a chosen penalty strength, not a unique consequence of the boundary condition. A fixed prescribed temperature has zero state derivative, but a wall-temperature design direction has nonzero δTb\delta T_b.

δRi,Eiso=δTi−δTw,δRi,Ead=−δκ GiT⋅ni−κ δGiT⋅ni−κ GiT⋅δni.\delta R_{i,E}^{\rm iso}=\delta T_i-\delta T_w,\quad \delta R_{i,E}^{\rm ad}=-\delta\kappa\,G_i^T\cdot n_i-\kappa\,\delta G_i^T\cdot n_i-\kappa\,G_i^T\cdot\delta n_i.

因此绝热节点行也包含邻域和几何导数。用一个局部温度对角项替代它，会丢掉真实离散条件的导数。

The adiabatic nodal row therefore includes stencil and geometry derivatives. Replacing it by a local temperature diagonal loses the derivative of the implemented condition.

第 4 节Section 4

离散残差与执行过程

Discrete residual and execution

跳到内部面，单步经过左加、右减。观察四个分量中的任一个如何逐步累加。

Jump to an interior face and step through add-left/subtract-right. Follow accumulation in any of the four components.

图 4.1：守恒分发与种子差Figure 4.1: Conservative scatter and seed difference

固定网格拓扑后的有限维函数

A finite-dimensional function at fixed topology

Rh(Uh,a,X)=Mbc[∑fBfHf−Sh]+Ebcc(Uh,a,X),Hf=∑s⊂f∑q=12ss2(F^nc−Fnv)q.R_h(\mathbf U_h,a,X)=M_{\rm bc}\left[\sum_f B_fH_f-S_h\right]+E_{\rm bc}c(\mathbf U_h,a,X),\quad H_f=\sum_{s\subset f}\sum_{q=1}^2\frac{s_s}{2}(\widehat F_n^c-F_n^v)_q.

BfB_f 向左控制体加通量、向右减通量。源项用每个多边形的三角剖分与七点三角求积，包含物理位置与权重。所有残差都是积分平衡量，不除以体积。先求梯度再逐面装配，不能在处理某个面时就覆盖邻居的梯度。

The incidence BfB_f adds flux to the left and subtracts it from the right. Sources use polygon triangulation and seven-point triangle quadrature, including physical locations and weights. Residuals are integrated balances without volume division. Compute gradients before the face loop rather than overwriting neighbour gradients during assembly.

geometry = areas, centroids, moments, subfaces, quadrature
coeff = weighted_quadratic_fit(conservative_states, geometry)
Rraw = 0
for face in topology:
    H = 0
    for segment and Gauss point:

        H += weight * (convective_flux - viscous_flux)
    Rraw[L] += H; if R >= 0: Rraw[R] -= H
Rraw -= integrated_sources
R = replace_boundary_rows_if_node(Rraw)

下面回放真实面计算和装配事件，局部表逐个显示该面求积点的数据，面通量表显示所有子面与求积点的和。它不是把完整标量运算图逐节点动画化；第 7、8 节提供这些事件内部的链式法则。末步误差比较回放数组和完整运算。

The player replays actual face computations and assembly events. Local quantities follow each quadrature point, while face fluxes sum every segment and point. This is not an animation of every scalar graph node; Sections 7 and 8 derive the internal chain rule. The final replay array is checked against the full operation.

从积分守恒定律逐步得到残差

Deriving the residual from integral conservation

对静止控制体写“积累率＋净流出＝体源”。对流减黏性的符号沿用第 2 节；散度定理把面积上的散度积分变成边界积分：

For a stationary volume write “accumulation + net outward flux = source.” With the convection-minus-viscosity convention, the divergence theorem converts area divergence into boundary flux:

ddt∫ViU dA+∫∂Vi(Fnc−Fnv) ds−∫ViS dA=0.\frac{d}{dt}\int_{V_i}U\,dA+\int_{\partial V_i}(F_n^c-F_n^v)\,ds-\int_{V_i}S\,dA=0.
steady:Riraw=∑fσifHf−Si,σif={+1i=L(f),−1i=R(f),0otherwise.\text{steady:}\qquad R_i^{\rm raw}=\sum_f\sigma_{if}H_f-S_i,\quad \sigma_{if}=\begin{cases}+1&i=L(f),\\-1&i=R(f),\\0&\text{otherwise}.\end{cases}

每个内部面只有一个四分量 HfH_f。左单元加它、右单元减它，因而求和时严格抵消。这是离散守恒最直接的检查，与是否使用一阶或二阶重构无关：

Each interior face has one four-component HfH_f, added left and subtracted right. It cancels in the global sum, regardless of reconstruction order:

∑iRiraw=∑f∈∂ΩhHf−∑iSi.\sum_iR_i^{\rm raw}=\sum_{f\in\partial\Omega_h}H_f-\sum_iS_i.

一个直子面的两个 Gauss 点为中点加减切向位移，每个权重都是半个面长。弯折对偶面分别对子面应用此公式。先对点求通量，后乘权重，不能把单位法向中的归一化面长又乘进去一次：

The two Gauss points on a straight segment are symmetric about its midpoint, with half-length weights. Apply this separately to bent dual segments. Evaluate point flux, then multiply its weight exactly once:

x±=xa+xb2±xb−xa23,Hf=∑s⊂fss2[Fn(x−)+Fn(x+)],Fn=F^nc−Fnv.x_\pm=\frac{x_a+x_b}{2}\pm\frac{x_b-x_a}{2\sqrt3},\quad H_f=\sum_{s\subset f}\frac{s_s}{2}[F_n(x_-)+F_n(x_+)],\quad F_n=\widehat F_n^c-F_n^v.

最后才覆盖格点强边界行。掩码矩阵 MbcM_{\rm bc} 的保留行对角为 1、覆盖行对角为 0；EbcE_{\rm bc} 把边界条件的数值填到指定位置。格心版 Mbc=IM_{\rm bc}=I，没有此覆盖步骤。

Strong nodal rows are replaced last. Diagonal mask MbcM_{\rm bc} is one for retained rows and zero for replaced rows; EbcE_{\rm bc} inserts constraints at their assigned positions. For cells Mbc=IM_{\rm bc}=I and there is no replacement.

第 5 节Section 5

Jacobian 与原始求解

Jacobian and primal solve

选择残差块行 i 与状态块列 j，查看 4×4 导数块，并在网格上辨认依赖邻域。

Choose block row i and column j, inspect the 4×4 derivative block, and locate the stencil on the mesh.

精确算子与便宜的三角修正

Exact operators and inexpensive triangular corrections

Ah=Rh,U,Ph=Rh,U(1),Bh=(DP+LP)−1.A_h=R_{h,U},\quad P_h=R_{h,U}^{(1)},\quad B_h=(D_P+L_P)^{-1}.

PhP_h 在同一当前状态将对流切换为一阶，仍完整保留二次黏性重构、物性和边界。每个对角块为 4×44\times4，梯度依赖会产生远于最近邻的块。当前小网格预处理显式组装 PhP_h，主导数接口则通过计算图提供 AvAv 和 ATwA^Tw。

At the same state, PhP_h switches convection to first order while retaining quadratic viscosity reconstruction, transport and boundaries. Diagonal blocks are 4×44\times4 and gradient dependencies extend beyond nearest neighbours. The small-grid preconditioner explicitly assembles PhP_h, while main derivative interfaces provide graph-based AvAv and ATwA^Tw.

AhΔU=−Rh,Uk+1=Uk+βkΔU.A_h\Delta U=-R_h,\qquad U^{k+1}=U^k+\beta_k\Delta U.

Newton 内部用 GS 预处理 GMRES；回溯步长要求正密度、正温度、支持的速度范围以及残差下降。收敛后重新线性化，稳态伴随不求解 Newton 迭代轨迹的反向传播。下方残差是原始非线性残差，不能与线性迭代混作一条曲线。

Newton uses GS-preconditioned GMRES and backtracking for positive density and temperature, supported speeds and residual decrease. Relinearize at convergence; the steady adjoint does not reverse the Newton iteration trajectory. The nonlinear residual below is distinct from inner linear convergence.

Newton 线性化与四乘四块

Newton linearization and four-by-four blocks

将第 i 个四分量残差对第 j 个四分量状态求偏导，得到 4×44\times4 块 AijA_{ij}。例如第一行、第二列是第 i 个质量残差对第 j 个 x 动量的导数。坐标和物理参数在这个偏导中保持固定：

Differentiating four residual components at i with respect to four state components at j produces a 4×44\times4 block AijA_{ij}. Its first-row, second-column entry differentiates mass residual i with respect to x-momentum j, holding coordinates and parameters fixed:

(Aij)αβ=∂Ri,α∂Uj,β,(Ahs)i=∑jAijsj.(A_{ij})_{\alpha\beta}=\frac{\partial R_{i,\alpha}}{\partial U_{j,\beta}},\qquad (A_hs)_i=\sum_jA_{ij}s_j.
Rh(Uk+ΔU)=Rh(Uk)+Ah(Uk)ΔU+O(∥ΔU∥2).R_h(U^k+\Delta U)=R_h(U^k)+A_h(U^k)\Delta U+O(\|\Delta U\|^2).

希望下一步残差接近零，忽略二次小量后就得到 AhΔU=−RhA_h\Delta U=-R_h。Newton 步很大时，高阶项不能忽略，回溯才有必要。预处理只用来更便宜地解这个线性系统；它不能用一阶近似 Jacobian 替代实际二阶残差的精确 Jacobian。

Setting the linearized residual to zero gives AhΔU=−RhA_h\Delta U=-R_h. Large steps make neglected higher terms important, motivating backtracking. Preconditioning accelerates this linear solve; it does not replace the required exact second-order Jacobian by a first-order one.

matrix-free 的含义是“计算矩阵乘向量而不存储整个主矩阵”，不是“不存在 Jacobian”。代码沿局部计算链求得 AhsA_hs 或 AhTwA_h^Tw；用于教学的小网格仍显式存储预处理矩阵 PhP_h。

Matrix-free means applying the main matrix without storing it, not that a Jacobian does not exist. Local chains produce AhsA_hs or AhTwA_h^Tw, while the small teaching-grid preconditioner PhP_h is explicitly stored.

第 6 节Section 6

目标函数与壁面收支

Objectives and wall budgets

先判断当前目标在哪里积分，再区分压力、黏性和热流贡献。制造解内圈不是固壁。

Locate the integration domain, then separate pressure, viscous and heat contributions. The MMS inner boundary is not a wall.

离散目标先于目标梯度

Define the discrete objective before its gradient

JT,h=12∑i,qwiq[T(Uirec(xiq))−(1+0.02cos⁡xiq)]2.J_{T,h}=\frac12\sum_{i,q}w_{iq}\left[T(U_i^{\rm rec}(x_{iq}))-(1+0.02\cos x_{iq})\right]^2.
Fbody,h=∑f∈Γw,qwfq(pbnf−τbnf),Qw,h=∑f∈Γw,qwfqqn,b.F_{\rm body,h}=\sum_{f\in\Gamma_w,q}w_{fq}(p_bn_f-\tau_bn_f),\qquad Q_{w,h}=\sum_{f\in\Gamma_w,q}w_{fq}q_{n,b}.

流体域外法向在物面指向物体，因此流体对物体的合力为 pn−τnpn-\tau n。热流正号表示从流体流出到物体。制造解的内圈不是固壁，其“力”选项只是同一内边界牵引泛函。目标求积的重构、温度转换、法向、面长和壁温都属于目标导数；不能只对最终压力数值求导。

At the body the fluid-outward normal points into the body, so fluid-on-body force is pn−τnpn-\tau n. Positive heat flows out of the fluid into the body. The manufactured inner boundary is not a solid wall; its force option is the same mathematical traction functional. Objective derivatives include reconstruction, temperature conversion, normals, length and wall temperature.

J˙h=jUTv+jaTda+jXTdX,jU∈R4N.\dot J_h=j_U^Tv+j_a^Td_a+j_X^Td_X,\qquad j_U\in\mathbb R^{4N}.

Display pressure and viscous contributions separately and verify their sum. Tracking uses the selected first/second-order convective reconstruction, not the quadratic viscous trace. Heat objectives generally have direct transport-parameter terms even at fixed flow.

温度跟踪目标的每一项导数

Every term in the temperature-tracking derivative

把每个求积点温度误差记为 dq=Tq−Ttarget,qd_q=T_q-T_{{\rm target},q}。平方项中的 1/21/2 与求导产生的 2 抵消，但几何方向还会改变权重和目标函数的采样位置：

Let dq=Tq−Ttarget,qd_q=T_q-T_{{\rm target},q}. Differentiating cancels the half with the derivative of a square. Geometry directions also change weights and the sampled target:

δJh=∑q[12dq2δwq+wqdq(δTq−δTtarget,q)],δTtarget,q=−0.02sin⁡(xq)δxq.\delta J_h=\sum_q\left[\frac12d_q^2\delta w_q+w_qd_q(\delta T_q-\delta T_{{\rm target},q})\right],\quad\delta T_{{\rm target},q}=-0.02\sin(x_q)\delta x_q.

An objective can change at fixed state: moving a face changes its normal and length, and viscosity changes shear. One force-quadrature contribution expands as:

δ[w(pn−τn)]=δw(pn−τn)+w[δp n+pδn−δτ n−τδn].\delta[w(pn-\tau n)]=\delta w(pn-\tau n)+w[\delta p\,n+p\delta n-\delta\tau\,n-\tau\delta n].

这就是后面把总梯度拆成“目标显式项”和“流场响应项”的原因。列梯度的定义是 δJ=jUTδU\delta J=j_U^T\delta U；jUj_U 是列，∂J/∂U\partial J/\partial U 按通常 Jacobian 约定是行。两种写法不能在同一个等式里漏掉转置。

This explains the later direct-objective and state-response contributions. A column gradient satisfies δJ=jUTδU\delta J=j_U^T\delta U; jUj_U is a column, whereas the usual Jacobian ∂J/∂U\partial J/\partial U is a row. Keep the transpose explicit.

第 9 节Section 9

前向方程求解

Tangent equation solve

选择一个物性参数，再选一个坐标方向。每次核对线性残差和目标方向导数。

Select a transport parameter, then a coordinate. Check the linear residual and objective directional derivative.

图 9.1：两未知量例子Figure 9.1: Two-unknown example

从隐函数得到状态响应

Obtain state response from the implicit equations

Rh(Uh(a,X),a,X)=0,Ahv=−Chda−GXdX,DJ^h[d]=jUTv+jaTda+jXTdX.R_h(U_h(a,X),a,X)=0,\quad A_hv=-C_hd_a-G_Xd_X,\quad D\widehat J_h[d]=j_U^Tv+j_a^Td_a+j_X^Td_X.
Ch=∂Rh∂a∈R4N×6,GX=∂Rh∂X∈R4N×2Nv,v=U˙h,da=a˙,dX=X˙.C_h=\frac{\partial R_h}{\partial a}\in\mathbb R^{4N\times6},\quad G_X=\frac{\partial R_h}{\partial X}\in\mathbb R^{4N\times2N_v},\quad v=\dot U_h,\quad d_a=\dot a,\quad d_X=\dot X.

先解收敛流场，再固定该基态的线性化。零状态种子与单位设计方向产生右端，解出的 vv 再与同一设计方向一起送进目标求导。一个方向对应一次 tangent 求解；并非把任意扰动经过一次 JVP 就完成了敏感度求解。

First converge the primal, then fix its linearization. Zero state seed and a unit design direction form the right-hand side. Feed the solved vv and the same design direction into the objective derivative. One design direction requires one tangent solve; a single arbitrary JVP is not that solve.

本页几何方向只移动所选节点，其他节点固定；攻角导数按弧度。图中显示的是守恒量响应，若需要速度或温度响应，还要经过上节的变量转换。

A coordinate direction moves just the selected node; other nodes are fixed. Incidence derivatives are per radian. Plotted responses are conserved quantities; velocity or temperature responses require the preceding variable conversion.

把“流场也随设计变化”写进链式法则

Include the design-induced state change

令一条设计路径为 a(ε)=a+εdaa(\varepsilon)=a+\varepsilon d_a、X(ε)=X+εdXX(\varepsilon)=X+\varepsilon d_X。每个设计都对应重新收敛的状态。因为路径上的残差始终为零，对它求导仍应等于零：

Consider a(ε)=a+εdaa(\varepsilon)=a+\varepsilon d_a and X(ε)=X+εdXX(\varepsilon)=X+\varepsilon d_X, with a converged state for each design. The residual remains zero along this path, so its derivative is zero:

0=ddεRh(Uh(ε),a(ε),X(ε))∣0=Ahs+Chda+GXdX.0=\left.\frac{d}{d\varepsilon}R_h(U_h(\varepsilon),a(\varepsilon),X(\varepsilon))\right|_0=A_hs+C_hd_a+G_Xd_X.
bd=−(Chda+GXdX),Ahs=bd,dJ^hdε=jUTs+jaTda+jXTdX.b_d=-(C_hd_a+G_Xd_X),\quad A_hs=b_d,\quad \frac{d\widehat J_h}{d\varepsilon}=j_U^Ts+j_a^Td_a+j_X^Td_X.

这里假设当前离散 Jacobian 可逆，从而局部状态响应唯一。这是隐函数定理的有限维条件，不是对所有流动分支的全局唯一性保证。AhsA_hs 的一次乘法只是给定 s 后求输出；求解 Ahs=bdA_hs=b_d 才是在找未知的 s。

Assume the current discrete Jacobian is invertible so the local response is unique: a finite-dimensional implicit-function condition, not global uniqueness of all flow branches. Applying AhsA_hs to a given s differs from solving for an unknown s.

[2−1−12][s1s2]=[10]⟹s2=s1/2,s1=2/3, s2=1/3.\begin{bmatrix}2&-1\\-1&2\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}s_1\\s_2\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix}1\\0\end{bmatrix}\quad\Longrightarrow\quad s_2=s_1/2,\quad s_1=2/3,\ s_2=1/3.

这个例子只是线性代数练习，不是将 N–S 简化成两条物理方程。它让我们不依赖程序即可核对后面的符号和转置。真实页面有 96 个状态未知量，但推导完全相同。

This is a linear-algebra exercise, not a two-equation physical N–S model. It lets us check signs and transposes by hand. The real page has 96 state unknowns, with the same derivation.

第 10 节Section 10

伴随方程求解

Adjoint equation solve

伴随只需求解一次；切换显示分量时，解释它为何是残差行权重而非流场变量。

One adjoint solve suffices. When viewing components, explain why they weight residual rows rather than represent flow variables.

有限维 Lagrangian 与列梯度约定

Finite-dimensional Lagrangian and column gradients

Lh=Jh+ψhTRh,L˙h=(jU+AhTψh)Tv+(ja+ChTψh)Tda+(jX+GXTψh)TdX.\mathcal L_h=J_h+\psi_h^TR_h,\qquad \dot{\mathcal L}_h=(j_U+A_h^T\psi_h)^Tv+(j_a+C_h^T\psi_h)^Td_a+(j_X+G_X^T\psi_h)^Td_X.
AhTψh=−jU,ga=ja+ChTψh,gX=jX+GXTψh.A_h^T\psi_h=-j_U,\qquad g_a=j_a+C_h^T\psi_h,\qquad g_X=j_X+G_X^T\psi_h.

所有 jj 都是列梯度。ψh\psi_h 对应最终离散残差的行，包括被替换的边界约束行，它不是连续速度或温度伴随场。因为收敛时 Rh=0R_h=0，乘子变化产生的项为零；令状态响应的系数为零即可消去 vv。同一目标只需一次伴随求解。

All jj are column gradients. The multiplier ψh\psi_h weights final residual rows, including replaced boundary constraints; it is not a continuous velocity or temperature adjoint. At convergence Rh=0R_h=0 eliminates multiplier-variation terms. Cancel the state-response coefficient to eliminate vv, requiring one adjoint solve per objective.

rψ=AhTψ~h+jU,(g~−g)Td=−rψTv.r_\psi=A_h^T\widetilde\psi_h+j_U,\qquad (\widetilde g-g)^Td=-r_\psi^Tv.

右端、线性算子和目标必须属于同一阶数、同一边界、同一收敛状态。上式在精确 tangent 下说明：小伴随残差只有结合状态响应幅度才能解释为小梯度误差。

Right-hand side, operator and objective must use the same order, boundary and converged state. With an exact tangent, the identity shows why a small adjoint residual must be interpreted together with the response magnitude.

逐行消去未知状态响应

Eliminate the unknown state response step by step

AhTψh=−jU,δJ^h=gaTda+gXTdX.A_h^T\psi_h=-j_U,\qquad \delta\widehat J_h=g_a^Td_a+g_X^Td_X.

在两未知量练习中，jU=(0,1)Tj_U=(0,1)^T，Ra=(−1,0)TR_a=(-1,0)^T，且没有目标显式项。直接手算可得：

2ψ1−ψ2=0,−ψ1+2ψ2=−1⟹ψ=(−1/3,−2/3)T,2\psi_1-\psi_2=0,\quad-\psi_1+2\psi_2=-1\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\psi=(-1/3,-2/3)^T,
g=0+(−1,0)ψ=1/3=jUTs.g=0+(-1,0)\psi=1/3=j_U^Ts.

前向适合少量设计方向、多个目标；伴随适合一个或少量目标、很多设计变量。本页每个目标解一次伴随，即可返回六个物理参数与全部坐标的梯度。伴随向量的分量是残差行的权重，并不是速度或温度本身。

Tangents suit a few directions and many objectives; adjoints suit a few objectives and many design variables. One adjoint here yields six physical-parameter and all coordinate gradients. Its components weight residual rows, not physical velocities or temperatures.

V=12∑k(xkyk+1−ykxk+1),V=\frac12\sum_k(x_ky_{k+1}-y_kx_{k+1}),

第 12 节Section 12

有限差分与 Taylor 检验

Finite differences and Taylor checks

选择一个方向并扫描步长；检查正负扰动残差后，再解释误差下降与回升。

Sweep steps for one direction. Inspect both perturbed residuals before interpreting the error curve.

每个步长都重新收敛

Reconverge for every step

Dk+=J^(a+εek)−J^(a)ε,Dk−=J^(a)−J^(a−εek)ε,Dk0=J^(a+εek)−J^(a−εek)2ε.D_k^+=\frac{\widehat J(a+\varepsilon e_k)-\widehat J(a)}\varepsilon,\quad D_k^-=\frac{\widehat J(a)-\widehat J(a-\varepsilon e_k)}\varepsilon,\quad D_k^0=\frac{\widehat J(a+\varepsilon e_k)-\widehat J(a-\varepsilon e_k)}{2\varepsilon}.
E2(ε)=∣J^(a+εek)−J^(a)−εgk∣.E_2(\varepsilon)=|\widehat J(a+\varepsilon e_k)-\widehat J(a)-\varepsilon g_k|.

可以选择全部六个物理参数及所有节点的 x/y 坐标，执行一个步长或完整步长扫描。每次重新构造几何、边界和流场。大步长有截断误差，小步长受浮点相消和原始容差影响；误差接近零时优先查看绝对误差。全部方向扫描较慢，计算中显示进度。

Select all six physical parameters and x/y coordinates of every vertex, for one step or a complete step sweep. Rebuild geometry, boundaries and primal flow each time. Large steps incur truncation error and small steps suffer cancellation and primal tolerance. Use absolute error near zero derivatives. All-direction sweeps are slower and display progress.

由 Taylor 展开预测差分误差

Predict difference errors using Taylor expansion

为了同时覆盖物理参数与坐标，本节把全部设计分量合记为 b，约化目标为 J^(b)=Jh(Uh(b),b)\widehat J(b)=J_h(U_h(b),b)。在可微的固定分支上沿单位方向展开：

Collect physical parameters and coordinates into b and write the reduced objective J^(b)=Jh(Uh(b),b)\widehat J(b)=J_h(U_h(b),b). Expand along a unit direction within a smooth fixed branch:

J^(b±εek)=J^(b)±εgk+12ε2Jkk±16ε3Jkkk+O(ε4).\widehat J(b\pm\varepsilon e_k)=\widehat J(b)\pm\varepsilon g_k+\tfrac12\varepsilon^2J_{kk}\pm\tfrac16\varepsilon^3J_{kkk}+O(\varepsilon^4).
Dk+=gk+12εJkk+O(ε2),Dk0=gk+16ε2Jkkk+O(ε4),E2=O(ε2).D_k^+=g_k+\tfrac12\varepsilon J_{kk}+O(\varepsilon^2),\quad D_k^0=g_k+\tfrac16\varepsilon^2J_{kkk}+O(\varepsilon^4),\quad E_2=O(\varepsilon^2).

正负相减消掉二次项，所以中心差分的截断误差通常比单边差分低一阶。但若每次目标求解带有误差 η\eta，除以步长会放大到 O(η/ε)O(\eta/\varepsilon)，因此图线不会随步长缩小而永远下降。曲线回升不一定是伴随写错，也可能是流场容差与浮点相消。

Subtracting opposite perturbations cancels the quadratic term, improving central truncation error by one order. However, objective-solve error η\eta contributes O(η/ε)O(\eta/\varepsilon). Thus the curve need not decrease indefinitely; an upturn may reflect solve tolerance or cancellation rather than an adjoint error.

若只在固定 U 上扰动参数，算到的是显式偏导 jaj_a，不是经过重新收敛的总导数。操作时先选一个坐标方向，查看不同步长、正负流场残差与伴随值，再切换到全部方向。

Perturbing parameters at fixed U yields only a direct partial derivative, not the reconverged total derivative. Start with one coordinate, inspect step sizes and both perturbed residuals, then switch to all directions.

第 13 节Section 13

独立复数算术

Independent complex arithmetic

用与差分相同的方向，比较独立复数运算和伴随导数。

Compare independent complex arithmetic and adjoint derivatives in the same direction as finite differences.

复数残差是另一条算术路径

Complex residuals use another arithmetic path

gk≃Im⁡Jh(UC,a+iεek)/ε,ε=10−25,AhΔv=−Im⁡Rh/ε.g_k\simeq\operatorname{Im}J_h(U^{\mathbb C},a+\mathrm i\varepsilon e_k)/\varepsilon,\quad\varepsilon=10^{-25},\qquad A_h\Delta v=-\operatorname{Im}R_h/\varepsilon.

从收敛实解开始，用复数四则运算、正值分支的分数幂和三角函数评估同一残差，再校正虚部。整数幂用代数乘法，避免对负实数做极坐标幂时引入与步长无关的虚部舍入。此路径不直接返回 tangent 结果，但校正线性系统仍复用实 Jacobian。

Start from the converged real state, evaluate the residual using complex arithmetic, positive-branch fractional powers and trigonometric functions, then correct its imaginary part. Integer powers use algebraic multiplication to avoid step-independent imaginary roundoff from polar powers of negative reals. The final result is not copied from a tangent, although corrections reuse the real Jacobian.

几何拓扑、边界分区和拟合邻域保持固定。有效性检查在实基态进行；不对复数作大小比较、绝对值 limiter 或裁剪。必须同时查看缩放虚部残差，而不是仅凭步长很小判断正确。

Topology, boundary partitions and fit stencils stay fixed. Admissibility is checked at the real base state, without complex ordering, absolute-value limiters or clipping. Inspect scaled imaginary residuals rather than trusting a small step by itself.

复数步长为何不需要相减

Why complex step avoids subtraction

J^(b+iεek)=J^(b)+iεgk−12ε2Jkk−i6ε3Jkkk+⋯ .\widehat J(b+\mathrm i\varepsilon e_k)=\widehat J(b)+\mathrm i\varepsilon g_k-\tfrac12\varepsilon^2J_{kk}-\tfrac{\mathrm i}{6}\varepsilon^3J_{kkk}+\cdots.
Im⁡J^(b+iεek)/ε=gk−16ε2Jkkk+⋯ .\operatorname{Im}\widehat J(b+\mathrm i\varepsilon e_k)/\varepsilon=g_k-\tfrac16\varepsilon^2J_{kkk}+\cdots.

它通过虚部隔离一次项，避免两个接近实数的目标值相减。但前提是整条残差计算在当前分支上能作解析延拓；例如使用绝对值直接处理复数，就会破坏这条展开。这里使用独立复数残差、固定拓扑及固定分支。

The imaginary part isolates the first-order term without subtracting nearby real objective values. The residual path must admit analytic continuation on the active branch; complex absolute values would invalidate the expansion. This implementation uses independent complex arithmetic and fixed topology and branches.

UC=U∗+iεs,Im⁡R(UC,b+iεd)ε=Ahs+Rbd+O(ε2).U^{\mathbb C}=U_*+\mathrm i\varepsilon s,\quad \frac{\operatorname{Im}R(U^{\mathbb C},b+\mathrm i\varepsilon d)}{\varepsilon}=A_hs+R_bd+O(\varepsilon^2).

因此实 Jacobian 可以用来校正缩放虚部残差，但最终目标虚部仍必须由复数运算独立算出。两种方法共用物理残差定义，所以通过复数检查仍不能单独证明物理模型和边界条件正确。

The real Jacobian can therefore correct the scaled imaginary residual, while the final imaginary objective is evaluated independently. Both routes share the residual definition, so agreement alone cannot prove physical modelling and boundary correctness.

Eh=[∑iVi∥Ui−U∗,i∥22∑iVi]1/2,ph=log⁡2(Eh/Eh/2).E_h=\left[\frac{\sum_iV_i\|U_i-U_{*,i}\|_2^2}{\sum_iV_i}\right]^{1/2},\qquad p_h=\log_2(E_h/E_{h/2}).

制造解检查的对象与二阶误差的含义

选好光滑的 U∗U_* 后，先代入连续物理通量并求散度，得到独立源项 S∗S_*。边界数据也由同一个解析场构造。然后求解离散方程并比较；若用离散残差本身来构造“源项”，就失去了检查空间离散误差的独立性。

Choose smooth U∗U_*, differentiate its physical flux to construct independent S∗S_*, and derive boundary data from that field. Solve the discrete problem and compare. Manufacturing a source from the discrete residual itself would remove this independent spatial-error check.

Eh≈Chp,Eh/2≈C(h/2)p⟹EhEh/2≈2p,p≈log⁡2(Eh/Eh/2).E_h\approx Ch^p,\quad E_{h/2}\approx C(h/2)^p\quad\Longrightarrow\quad \frac{E_h}{E_{h/2}}\approx2^p,\quad p\approx\log_2(E_h/E_{h/2}).

第 15 节Section 15

连续对照与验证范围

Continuum comparison and scope

Distinguish transpose products, total gradients, spatial accuracy and continuum checks.

三个不同层次的正确性

Three different levels of correctness

点积测试检查转置；全重算差分检查实际离散目标的总导数；制造解加密检查离散解对连续方程的逼近。它们不是同一个检查，也不能互相替代。连续参考的独立性应来自不同方程/边值求解路线，而不是换一个符号调用同一矩阵。

Dot tests check transposition; reconverged differences check total derivatives of the actual discrete objective; manufactured refinement checks approximation of the continuum equation. These are distinct tests. Independence requires a different equation/boundary-solve route, not renaming the same matrix.

Dividing integrated residuals by volume changes multiplier values but not converged total gradients. Strong boundary rows need their own scales. Do not subtract the discrete ψh\psi_h directly from continuum λ(x,y)\lambda(x,y). The appendix provides the full 2D derivation, an independent O-domain BVP solve and manufactured-objective gradient validation, plus the retained plane-1D ODE comparison. Tracking now uses a local P₁/P₂ continuous weak form, local refinement and independent primal reruns. Same-mesh FD agreement and continuum resolution are reported separately. A~Tψ~=ATD−TDTψ=ATψ=−jU.\widetilde A^T\widetilde\psi=A^TD^{-T}D^T\psi=A^T\psi=-j_U.

GS, GMRES and LU

Compare GS, GMRES and LU for the same adjoint system, using true residuals to judge convergence.

便宜修正始终针对精确系统

Inexpensive correction still targets the exact system

Forward block GS sweeps forward; its transpose sweeps backward and transposes every block. Stationary convergence requires ρ(I−ωBKK)<1\rho(I-\omega B_KK)<1, not a method name. Budget exhaustion or growth must be shown as nonconvergence.

KBKVm=Vm+1H‾m,ym=arg⁡min⁡y∥βe1−H‾my∥2,xm=BKVmym.KB_KV_m=V_{m+1}\overline H_m,\quad y_m=\arg\min_y\|\beta e_1-\overline H_my\|_2,\quad x_m=B_KV_my_m.

GMRES 使用右预处理，Arnoldi 正交化两次；每轮恢复解并计算真残差，必要时重启。比较时使用同一个基态、同一个右端和同一真残差尺度。LU 的准备包括显式组装和分解；小网格的速度不能直接推广到工业规模。

GMRES uses right preconditioning and two orthogonalization passes, reconstructing solutions to measure true residuals and restarting if needed. Compare the same base, right-hand side and true-residual scale. LU preparation includes assembly and factorization; small-grid timing does not prescribe industrial-scale methods.

从三角方程得到 GS 扫描式

Derive the GS sweep from a triangular system

将预处理矩阵分成块对角 D、严格下三角 L 和严格上三角 U。一次从零开始的前向 GS 扫描就是求解 (D+L)z=r(D+L)z=r；逐行把已经求出的量移到右侧：

Split the preconditioner into block diagonal D, strict lower L and strict upper U. A forward GS sweep from zero solves (D+L)z=r(D+L)z=r. Move already known terms to the right:

Piizi+∑j<iPijzj=ri⟹zi=Pii−1(ri−∑j<iPijzj).P_{ii}z_i+\sum_{j<i}P_{ij}z_j=r_i\quad\Longrightarrow\quad z_i=P_{ii}^{-1}\left(r_i-\sum_{j<i}P_{ij}z_j\right).

对伴随使用这个线性作用的精确转置：先转置三角系统，再从后往前解。它不等于“仍然从前往后扫一遍，只把名称改成 adjoint”。

For the adjoint use the exact transpose of this linear action: transpose the triangular system and solve backward.

(D+L)Tz=r⟹zi=Pii−T(ri−∑j>iPjiTzj).(D+L)^Tz=r\quad\Longrightarrow\quad z_i=P_{ii}^{-T}\left(r_i-\sum_{j>i}P_{ji}^Tz_j\right).

从固定点误差到 GMRES 的最小二乘

From fixed-point error to GMRES least squares

ek+1=xk+1−x∗=(I−ωBKK)ek,Kx∗=b.e^{k+1}=x^{k+1}-x_*=(I-\omega B_KK)e^k,\quad Kx_*=b.

误差传播矩阵决定固定点是否收敛。GMRES 则在逐步扩大的子空间里选择使残差最小的修正。令当前残差 r0=b−Kx0r_0=b-Kx_0，β=∥r0∥\beta=\|r_0\|，从 v1=r0/βv_1=r_0/\beta 开始反复作用 KBKKB_K 并正交化，得到 Arnoldi 关系：

The error-propagation matrix controls stationary convergence. GMRES instead chooses a residual-minimizing correction in an expanding subspace. Set r0=b−Kx0r_0=b-Kx_0, β=∥r0∥\beta=\|r_0\|, start with v1=r0/βv_1=r_0/\beta, and repeatedly apply and orthogonalize KBKKB_K:

KBKVm=Vm+1H‾m,xm=x0+BKVmy,KB_KV_m=V_{m+1}\overline H_m,\quad x_m=x_0+B_KV_my,
b−Kxm=r0−KBKVmy=Vm+1(βe1−H‾my).b-Kx_m=r_0-KB_KV_my=V_{m+1}(\beta e_1-\overline H_my).

由于 Vm+1V_{m+1} 的列正交归一，上式的二范数等于小向量的二范数，最终只需解一个小规模最小二乘问题。若 x0≠0x_0\ne0，修正公式里不能漏掉它；本页每次 GMRES 修正从零初值开始，再加回外层解。

Because the columns of Vm+1V_{m+1} are orthonormal, its residual norm equals the norm of the small vector, leaving a small least-squares problem. Retain x0x_0 for nonzero starts; this implementation solves zero-start corrections and adds them to the outer iterate.

第 17 节Section 17

总结

Summary

按“存储 → 重构 → 通量 → 装配 → 求导 → 求解 → 验证”复述一次完整计算。

Explain the full sequence: storage → reconstruction → flux → assembly → differentiation → solve → verify.

从二维标量到二维 N–S，面装配仍是“左加右减”，但单个通量背后已包含四个守恒量、多点重构、应力张量、导热、无滑移或自然牵引边界。精确离散伴随必须反转整条计算链，而不是只转置无粘通量。

From the scalar equation to 2D N–S, face assembly remains add-left/subtract-right, but each flux includes four states, multipoint reconstruction, stress, heat and no-slip or natural-traction boundaries. An exact discrete adjoint reverses the entire chain, not only inviscid fluxes.

Rh=0 ⟶ Ahv=−Rh,ad ⟶ AhTψh=−jU ⟶ g=ja+Rh,aTψh.R_h=0\ \longrightarrow\ A_hv=-R_{h,a}d\ \longrightarrow\ A_h^T\psi_h=-j_U\ \longrightarrow\ g=j_a+R_{h,a}^T\psi_h.

当前范围是小型固定拓扑、无 limiter、无激波的层流教学系统。它展示通向二维非结构 RANS 所需的几何、黏性和边界求导；湍流模型及其边界、网格变形映射、并行分区和大规模稀疏求解仍是后续内容。判断正确性时，应同时看数学定义、实际执行、局部验证与全链路验证。

The current scope is a small fixed-topology, unlimited, shock-free laminar teaching system. It demonstrates geometry, viscous and boundary derivatives needed on the path to 2D unstructured RANS. Turbulence and its boundaries, mesh-motion maps, parallel partitioning and large sparse solves remain future work. Judge definitions, actual execution, local checks and full-chain checks together.

建议按一条完整计算链复习

Review one complete computation chain

先在网格上选一个面，说清左右存储量、求积点与法向；再用该面检查对流、应力与热流的符号。随后播放残差、前向与反向，核对邻域贡献为什么需要累加。最后选择一个物理参数或坐标，比较 tangent、adjoint、不同步长差分及复数步长。做到这些后，再看加密图判断空间精度；两种判断回答的是不同问题。

Choose one physical parameter or coordinate and compare tangent, adjoint, finite-difference steps and complex step. Then use refinement to assess spatial accuracy: it answers a different question.

B=∫∂Ω[λTδFn−(∂jλ)TDjknkδU]ds.\mathcal B=\int_{\partial\Omega}\left[\lambda^T\delta F_n-(\partial_j\lambda)^TD_{jk}n_k\delta U\right]ds.

内部扰动可以任意取，因此方括号必须为零。这给出二维连续伴随的紧凑形式。系数依赖基态和空间，故必须保留 ∂k(DjkT∂jλ)\partial_k(D_{jk}^T\partial_j\lambda) 的乘积导数；把它直接写成常系数二阶导数会遗漏项。下面进一步展开，使读者无需先构造四个黏性矩阵。

Interior variations are arbitrary, so the bracket must vanish. This is the compact two-dimensional adjoint. Coefficients depend on the base field and position: retain the product derivative ∂k(DjkT∂jλ)\partial_k(D_{jk}^T\partial_j\lambda). Replacing it by a constant-coefficient second derivative loses terms. We next expand the equation without requiring the reader to construct all viscous matrices first.

A.5 用原始变量收集系数：伴随应力的来源

A.5 Collect primitive-variable coefficients: the adjoint stress

第一次分部积分后，体积分中与通量有关的项是 −(∂jλ)TδFj-(\partial_j\lambda)^T\delta F_j。把 A.2 逐项代入。与应力变化相乘的系数，以及与温度梯度变化相乘的系数分别为：

After the first integration by parts, the flux term is −(∂jλ)TδFj-(\partial_j\lambda)^T\delta F_j. Substitute A.2 term by term. The weights of stress variation and temperature-gradient variation are:

aj=∂jα,Bij=∂jβi,cj=∂jχ,Qij=Bij+uicj,Zij=μ(Qij+Qji−23Qkkδij).a_j=\partial_j\alpha,\quad B_{ij}=\partial_j\beta_i,\quad c_j=\partial_j\chi,\quad Q_{ij}=B_{ij}+u_i c_j,\quad Z_{ij}=\mu\left(Q_{ij}+Q_{ji}-\tfrac23Q_{kk}\delta_{ij}\right).
Qijδτij=Zij∂jδui+μTQijsijδT,−cjδqj=κcj∂jδT+κTcj(∂jT)δT.Q_{ij}\delta\tau_{ij}=Z_{ij}\partial_j\delta u_i+\mu_TQ_{ij}s_{ij}\delta T,\qquad-c_j\delta q_j=\kappa c_j\partial_j\delta T+\kappa_Tc_j(\partial_jT)\delta T.

例如 Qij∂iδujQ_{ij}\partial_i\delta u_j 交换求和下标后成为 Qji∂jδuiQ_{ji}\partial_j\delta u_i，所以出现 Q+QTQ+Q^T；迹项给出 −23tr⁡(Q)I-\tfrac23\operatorname{tr}(Q)I。ZZ 是这次分部积分产生的系数张量，不是原流场的应力。它还包含 ui∂jχu_i\partial_j\chi，这正是黏性功的反向耦合。二维分量为：

For example, swapping summed indices changes Qij∂iδujQ_{ij}\partial_i\delta u_j into Qji∂jδuiQ_{ji}\partial_j\delta u_i, producing Q+QTQ+Q^T. The trace term supplies −23tr⁡(Q)I-\tfrac23\operatorname{tr}(Q)I. Z is an integration-by-parts coefficient tensor, not the primal stress. Its ui∂jχu_i\partial_j\chi term is the reverse coupling from viscous work. In two dimensions:

Z11=μ(43Q11−23Q22),Z22=μ(43Q22−23Q11),Z12=Z21=μ(Q12+Q21).Z_{11}=\mu(\tfrac43Q_{11}-\tfrac23Q_{22}),\quad Z_{22}=\mu(\tfrac43Q_{22}-\tfrac23Q_{11}),\quad Z_{12}=Z_{21}=\mu(Q_{12}+Q_{21}).
∫ΩZij∂jδui=∫∂ΩZijnjδui−∫Ω(∂jZij)δui,\int_\Omega Z_{ij}\partial_j\delta u_i=\int_{\partial\Omega}Z_{ij}n_j\delta u_i-\int_\Omega(\partial_jZ_{ij})\delta u_i,
∫Ωκcj∂jδT=∫∂Ωκ∂nχ δT−∫Ω∂j(κ∂jχ)δT.\int_\Omega\kappa c_j\partial_j\delta T=\int_{\partial\Omega}\kappa\partial_n\chi\,\delta T-\int_\Omega\partial_j(\kappa\partial_j\chi)\delta T.

A.6 The four expanded two-dimensional adjoint equations

记 rz=fz−λTSzr_z=f_z-\lambda^TS_z，其中 zz 是一个原始变量。收集 δρ,δu1,δu2,δT\delta\rho,\delta u_1,\delta u_2,\delta T 的系数，分别置零。密度方程是：

Write rz=fz−λTSzr_z=f_z-\lambda^TS_z for a primitive variable z. Collect and set to zero the coefficients of δρ,δu1,δu2,δT\delta\rho,\delta u_1,\delta u_2,\delta T. The density equation is:

Eρ=rρ−uj∂jα−uiuj∂jβi−T∂iβi−Huj∂jχ=0.\mathcal E_\rho=r_\rho-u_j\partial_j\alpha-u_i u_j\partial_j\beta_i-T\partial_i\beta_i-Hu_j\partial_j\chi=0.

对每个速度分量 i=1,2i=1,2，得到两个方程：

For each velocity component i=1,2i=1,2, obtain two equations:

Eui=rui−ρ∂iα−ρuj∂jβi−ρuk∂iβk−ρH∂iχ−ρuiuj∂jχ+τij∂jχ−∂jZij=0.\begin{aligned}\mathcal E_{u_i}={}&r_{u_i}-\rho\partial_i\alpha-\rho u_j\partial_j\beta_i-\rho u_k\partial_i\beta_k\\&-\rho H\partial_i\chi-\rho u_i u_j\partial_j\chi+\tau_{ij}\partial_j\chi-\partial_jZ_{ij}=0.\end{aligned}

温度方程为：

The temperature equation is:

ET=rT−ρ∂iβi−ρcpuj∂jχ+μTQijsij+κT∂jT∂jχ−∂j(κ∂jχ)=0.\mathcal E_T=r_T-\rho\partial_i\beta_i-\rho c_pu_j\partial_j\chi+\mu_TQ_{ij}s_{ij}+\kappa_T\partial_jT\partial_j\chi-\partial_j(\kappa\partial_j\chi)=0.

式中 Q:s=Q11s11+Q12s12+Q21s21+Q22s22Q:s=Q_{11}s_{11}+Q_{12}s_{12}+Q_{21}s_{21}+Q_{22}s_{22}，两个剪切位置都要计入。若 κ\kappa 只随 TT 变化且参数空间均匀，导热的后两项恰好合成 −κΔχ-\kappa\Delta\chi；这不是允许在其他项中冻结变物性。黏度导数项 μTQ:s\mu_TQ:s 仍保留，∂jZij\partial_jZ_{ij} 也仍须对 μ(T)\mu(T) 求空间导数。

The contraction Q:s=Q11s11+Q12s12+Q21s21+Q22s22Q:s=Q_{11}s_{11}+Q_{12}s_{12}+Q_{21}s_{21}+Q_{22}s_{22} includes both shear positions. If conductivity depends only on T and parameters are spatially uniform, its last two terms combine to −κΔχ-\kappa\Delta\chi. This cancellation does not permit freezing transport elsewhere: μTQ:s\mu_TQ:s remains, and ∂jZij\partial_jZ_{ij} still differentiates μ(T)\mu(T) in space.

κT∇T⋅∇χ−∇⋅(κ∇χ)=−κΔχ(κ=κ(T)).\kappa_T\nabla T\cdot\nabla\chi-\nabla\cdot(\kappa\nabla\chi)=-\kappa\Delta\chi\quad(\kappa=\kappa(T)).

这四个方程仍以守恒残差的乘子 λ=(α,β1,β2,χ)\lambda=(\alpha,\beta_1,\beta_2,\chi) 为未知，只是用原始变量扰动收集系数。不是把乘子偷偷换成另一套变量。令 M=∂U/∂WM=\partial U/\partial W，则展开系数 EW=MTEU\mathcal E_W=M^T\mathcal E_U；ρ,T>0\rho,T>0 下 MM 可逆，两种形式等价：

The unknowns are still the conservative-residual multipliers λ=(α,β1,β2,χ)\lambda=(\alpha,\beta_1,\beta_2,\chi); only the variation coordinates changed. With M=∂U/∂WM=\partial U/\partial W, the expanded coefficients satisfy EW=MTEU\mathcal E_W=M^T\mathcal E_U. The invertible change of variables makes both forms equivalent:

M=[1000u1ρ00u20ρ0Eρu1ρu2ρcv],det⁡M=ρ3cv>0.M=\begin{bmatrix}1&0&0&0\\u_1&\rho&0&0\\u_2&0&\rho&0\\E&\rho u_1&\rho u_2&\rho c_v\end{bmatrix},\qquad\det M=\rho^3c_v>0.

密度对应方程没有独立的二阶扩散项，不能给四个伴随分量一律施加同一种 Dirichlet 条件。黏性并没有把可压缩 N–S 变成四个独立的 Poisson 方程。

The density equation has no independent second-order diffusion term. One cannot impose the same Dirichlet condition on all four adjoint components. Viscosity does not turn compressible N–S into four independent Poisson equations.

A.7 一个通用边界式，决定全部伴随边界条件

A.7 One boundary form determines the adjoint conditions

Fn=[ρunρu1un+t1ρu2un+t2ρEun+uiti+qn],un=ujnj,A=α+βiui+χE.F_n=\begin{bmatrix}\rho u_n\\\rho u_1u_n+t_1\\\rho u_2u_n+t_2\\\rho E u_n+u_it_i+q_n\end{bmatrix},\quad u_n=u_jn_j,\quad A=\alpha+\beta_i u_i+\chi E.

固定几何，先把法向总通量改写为边界数据 t,qnt,q_n 的形式，再求变化。定义 b\mathfrak b 为不含目标变化的边界密度，则：

At fixed geometry, rewrite the normal total flux in terms of boundary data t,qnt,q_n before varying it. Let b\mathfrak b denote the boundary density excluding the objective variation:

b=unA δρ+[ρAn+ρun(β+χu)+χt+Zn]⋅δu+[ρcvunχ+κ∂nχ]δT+(β+χu)⋅δt+χδqn.\begin{aligned}\mathfrak b={}&u_nA\,\delta\rho+\left[\rho A n+\rho u_n(\beta+\chi u)+\chi t+Zn\right]\cdot\delta u\\&+\left[\rho c_vu_n\chi+\kappa\partial_n\chi\right]\delta T+(\beta+\chi u)\cdot\delta t+\chi\delta q_n.\end{aligned}
δWL=∫ΩEWTδW dΩ+∫∂Ωb ds+∫Γwδg ds.\delta_W\mathscr L=\int_\Omega\mathcal E_W^T\delta W\,d\Omega+\int_{\partial\Omega}\mathfrak b\,ds+\int_{\Gamma_w}\delta g\,ds.

该式是 A.4 边界项的原始变量展开。边界上的 δW,δt,δqn\delta W,\delta t,\delta q_n 不能全部视为互相独立，更不能全部设零；它们必须满足原边界条件的线性化。正确做法是先代入已知为零的变化，再对剩余自由变化令系数消失。边界有目标时，还要先加上 δg\delta g。

This is A.4's boundary term expanded in primitive variables. Boundary variations δW,δt,δqn\delta W,\delta t,\delta q_n are neither all independent nor all zero: they satisfy the linearized primal boundary conditions. Substitute prescribed variations first, then cancel coefficients of the remaining free variations. Include δg\delta g before doing this on an objective boundary.

A.8 入口与总牵引出口

A.8 Inflow and total-traction outflow

入口给定 ρ,u1,u2,T\rho,u_1,u_2,T，固定参数时 δW=0\delta W=0。法向速度梯度、温度梯度仍可改变，所以 δt\delta t 与 δqn\delta q_n 可以非零。若入口没有边界目标，则边界式化为 (β+χu)⋅δt+χδqn(\beta+\chi u)\cdot\delta t+\chi\delta q_n，从而：

Inflow prescribes ρ,u1,u2,T\rho,u_1,u_2,T, so δW=0\delta W=0 at fixed parameters. Normal velocity and temperature gradients may still change, making δt\delta t and δqn\delta q_n nonzero. Without an inlet objective, the boundary form reduces to (β+χu)⋅δt+χδqn(\beta+\chi u)\cdot\delta t+\chi\delta q_n, hence:

Γin:χ=0,β1=β2=0.\Gamma_{\rm in}:\qquad\chi=0,\quad\beta_1=\beta_2=0.

入口不另加 α\alpha 的边界值。

No additional inlet value is imposed for α\alpha.

总牵引出口固定 t=tb,qn=qbt=t_b,q_n=q_b，所以 δt=0,δqn=0\delta t=0,\delta q_n=0，而 δρ,δu,δT\delta\rho,\delta u,\delta T 的边界迹是自由的。无出口目标且 un>0u_n>0 时：

At a total-traction outlet, fixed t=tb,qn=qbt=t_b,q_n=q_b gives δt=0,δqn=0\delta t=0,\delta q_n=0, leaving the boundary traces of δρ,δu,δT\delta\rho,\delta u,\delta T free. With no outlet objective and un>0u_n>0:

A=0,Zn+ρun(β+χu)+χtb=0,κ∂nχ+ρcvunχ=0.A=0,\qquad Zn+\rho u_n(\beta+\chi u)+\chi t_b=0,\qquad\kappa\partial_n\chi+\rho c_vu_n\chi=0.

第一个条件等价于 α=−β⋅u−χE\alpha=-\beta\cdot u-\chi E；第二个是两个耦合的导数条件；第三个是能量伴随的 Robin 条件。它们来自本页“总牵引 + 热流”出口，不能换成“给定压力”出口的伴随条件。若 un=0u_n=0，未约简的条件只有 unA=0u_nA=0，不能除以 unu_n；若发生回流，还必须重新分析原边界问题的信息数和稳定性。当前推导不为这两类退化情形作适定性保证。

The first condition gives α=−β⋅u−χE\alpha=-\beta\cdot u-\chi E; the second is a pair of coupled derivative conditions, and the third is a Robin condition for the energy multiplier. These belong to the implemented total-traction-plus-heat outlet, not a prescribed-pressure outlet. If un=0u_n=0, retain the unreduced unA=0u_nA=0 rather than dividing. Backflow requires a fresh analysis of the primal boundary problem and stability. No well-posedness claim is made for either degeneracy.

A.9 静止壁面：目标函数改变伴随边界值

A.9 Stationary walls: the objective changes adjoint boundary values

静止无滑移壁面有 u=0,δu=0,un=0u=0,\delta u=0,u_n=0，所以即使 δρ\delta\rho 自由，它在边界式中的系数仍为零。力／热流目标变化为 δg=d⋅δt+ηδqn\delta g=d\cdot\delta t+\eta\delta q_n（此处 d,ηd,\eta 固定）。代入后只剩：

At a stationary no-slip wall, u=0,δu=0,un=0u=0,\delta u=0,u_n=0. Density may vary but its boundary coefficient vanishes. With fixed d and eta, δg=d⋅δt+ηδqn\delta g=d\cdot\delta t+\eta\delta q_n. The remaining form is:

b+δg=(β+d)⋅δt+(χ+η)δqn+κ∂nχ δT.\mathfrak b+\delta g=(\beta+d)\cdot\delta t+(\chi+\eta)\delta q_n+\kappa\partial_n\chi\,\delta T.

等温壁固定 T=TwT=T_w，因此 δT=0\delta T=0，热流可以变化。绝热壁固定 qn=0q_n=0，因此 δqn=0\delta q_n=0，温度可以变化。分别消去自由项，得到：

An isothermal wall fixes T=TwT=T_w, giving δT=0\delta T=0 while heat may vary. An adiabatic wall fixes qn=0q_n=0, giving δqn=0\delta q_n=0 while temperature may vary. Cancel the respective free terms:

Γiso:β=−d,χ=−η;Γad:β=−d,∂nχ=0.\Gamma_{\rm iso}:\quad\beta=-d,\quad\chi=-\eta;\qquad\Gamma_{\rm ad}:\quad\beta=-d,\quad\partial_n\chi=0.

这些壁面都不另外指定 α\alpha。绝热热流目标恒为零，在唯一可解的齐次伴随问题中可以取 λ=0\lambda=0；但若把规定热流本身作为参数，允许 δqb≠0\delta q_b\ne0，就不再是同一个“固定绝热”方向。制造解内圈若有力目标，在入口应改成 β=−d,χ=0\beta=-d,\chi=0；热流目标应改成 χ=−η,β=−χu\chi=-\eta,\beta=-\chi u。在固定牵引／热流出口，这两个目标的状态变化为零，但它们仍可有显式参数导数。

No additional alpha condition is imposed at either wall. For a fixed adiabatic heat objective, J is identically zero; the unique homogeneous adjoint, when it exists, is zero. Varying prescribed heat itself with δqb≠0\delta q_b\ne0 is a different design direction. If the MMS inner inlet carries a force objective, use β=−d,χ=0\beta=-d,\chi=0; for heat use χ=−η,β=−χu\chi=-\eta,\beta=-\chi u. At a fixed-traction/fixed-heat outlet these objectives have zero state variation, but may still have explicit parameter derivatives.

A.10 固定域上的参数梯度

A.10 Parameter gradients on a fixed domain

连续伴随消掉未知流场响应后，仍要保留通量、源项、目标和边界数据对参数的显式依赖。先令边界数据与参数无关，并以 Fj,aF_{j,a} 表示固定 W,∇WW,\nabla W 的偏导：

After eliminating the unknown state response, retain explicit parameter dependence of flux, source, objective and boundary data. First suppose boundary data are parameter independent, and let Fj,aF_{j,a} denote a partial derivative at fixed W,∇WW,\nabla W:

δJ^c=∫Ω[faδa−(∂jλ)TFj,aδa−λTSaδa]dΩ+∫∂ΩλTFn,aδa ds+∫Γwgaδa ds.\delta\widehat J^{\rm c}=\int_\Omega\left[f_a\delta a-(\partial_j\lambda)^TF_{j,a}\delta a-\lambda^TS_a\delta a\right]d\Omega+\int_{\partial\Omega}\lambda^TF_{n,a}\delta a\,ds+\int_{\Gamma_w}g_a\delta a\,ds.

这是从尚未代入参数边界变化的 Lagrangian 得到的通式。若原边界算子也依赖物性或规定数据，δW\delta W 的边界变化不再齐次，还必须加回 A.7 对该非齐次变化产生的边界项。下面用总的 δt,δqn\delta t,\delta q_n 消去自由变化，能避免把物性边界项算两次。对空间均匀的物性参数，体积分中的显式输运部分是：

This general formula precedes parameter-dependent boundary substitution. If a primal boundary operator depends on transport or prescribed data, boundary state variations become inhomogeneous and their A.7 contributions must be included. Using total δt,δqn\delta t,\delta q_n to eliminate free variations avoids counting transport boundary terms twice. For spatially uniform transport parameters the explicit volume contribution is:

∫Ω[μa Q:s+κa∇χ⋅∇T−λTSa+fa]δa dΩ.\int_\Omega\left[\mu_a\,Q:s+\kappa_a\nabla\chi\cdot\nabla T-\lambda^TS_a+f_a\right]\delta a\,d\Omega.

In practice combine this volume term with the total boundary form after all boundary conditions are substituted, without adding λTFn,a\lambda^TF_{n,a} a second time. δJin=∫Γin[unα δρb+(ραn+Zn)⋅δub+κ∂nχ δTb]ds,\delta J_{\rm in}=\int_{\Gamma_{\rm in}}\left[u_n\alpha\,\delta\rho_b+(\rho\alpha n+Zn)\cdot\delta u_b+\kappa\partial_n\chi\,\delta T_b\right]ds,

Explicit objective dependence on boundary data also remains, such as ηδqb\eta\delta q_b for heat. Added heating SE=ahsin⁡2(0.7x1+0.5x2)S_E=a_h\sin^2(0.7x_1+0.5x_2) contributes:

dJ^cdah=−∫Ωχsin⁡2(0.7x1+0.5x2) dΩ.\frac{d\widehat J^{\rm c}}{da_h}=-\int_\Omega\chi\sin^2(0.7x_1+0.5x_2)\,d\Omega.

A.11 几何变化不能混进固定域公式

A.11 Geometry changes require a domain transformation

正文还提供坐标导数。要构造连续的对应量，必须先规定连续变形，而不能把一个网格节点编号当成连续设计变量。设 xε=x+εV(x)x_\varepsilon=x+\varepsilon V(x)，KV=∇VK_V=\nabla V，采用拉回到基准域的材料变化 W˙\dot W。链式法则、面积与法向变化给出：

A.13 边界消项交互与适定性边界

A.13 Boundary cancellation and the limits of well-posedness claims

下方使用一个法向倾斜的边界点，代入符合原始边界条件的测试变化，再检查 b+δg\mathfrak b+\delta g。选择力或热流目标时，可比较正确的非齐次伴随条件与“全部伴随值设零”的错误选择。出口演示使用 un>0u_n>0；这里检验边界代数，不求解整个流场。

The panel below uses one oblique boundary point and test variations admissible for the primal condition, checking b+δg\mathfrak b+\delta g. Force and heat objectives allow comparison of the correct inhomogeneous adjoint conditions against incorrectly setting all adjoint values to zero. The outlet example uses un>0u_n>0. This tests boundary algebra, not an entire flow solve.

消去形式边界项是必要步骤，但不是存在性、唯一性或稳定性的证明。还需要原始解所在函数空间、线性化算子的可逆性、足够正则的边界与兼容数据。质量方程的退化结构、出口回流、驻点、角点以及热流／应力目标的边界正则性都可能影响适定性。这里不把离散矩阵可逆或点积测试通过当成连续问题适定的证明。

Canceling the formal boundary form is necessary but does not prove existence, uniqueness or stability. Function spaces, invertibility of the linearized operator, boundary regularity and compatible data remain required. Degenerate mass diffusion, outlet backflow, stagnation, corners and boundary regularity for heat/stress objectives may affect well-posedness. An invertible discrete matrix or a successful dot test does not prove the continuum problem well posed.

Given a smooth primal base W and an explicitly defined objective:

  4. Discretize this continuous BVP independently; solve and refine it.
  5. Evaluate parameter / geometry formulas with all boundary-data terms.
  6. Compare independently reconverged continuum differences.
The independent solver in A.14-A.15 implements these steps for the
explicitly stated smooth verification family; shape solves are separate.

A.14 真正求解二维连续伴随边值问题

A.14 Solve the two-dimensional continuous-adjoint BVP

这里求解的是 A.6 的四个连续偏微分方程及 A.8–A.9 的边界条件，而不是正文有限体积 Jacobian 的转置。区域完全沿用本页的 O 型多边形：8 个四边形与 16 个三角形，内孔保留。连续乘子 λ=(α,β1,β2,χ)T\lambda=(\alpha,\beta_1,\beta_2,\chi)^T 同时依赖 x,yx,y，包括混合导数、剪切应力、黏性功、热传导及 Sutherland 物性的全部导数。格心页与格点页共享这个独立连续参考；连续场的未知数不是正文的单元平均值或节点值。

This solves the four continuous PDEs in A.6 and the boundary conditions in A.8–A.9, not the transpose of the main finite-volume Jacobian. It uses exactly the same O-shaped polygon: eight quadrilaterals and sixteen triangles, retaining the inner hole. All four multipliers depend on x and y, including mixed derivatives, shear, viscous work, heat conduction and all Sutherland derivatives. The cell and node pages share this independent reference; its unknowns are not the main lesson’s averages or nodal states.

为让小型教学程序独立且易于检查，用总次数不超过 pp 的二维 Chebyshev 多项式逼近每个乘子。它在整个区域连续可微，因此不需要再引入跨单元的伴随数值通量。网格单元用来定义区域与求积；增加 pp 增加未知系数，绘图的细分只改善着色。这里的 p=3,5,7,9p=3,5,7,9 是独立连续参考的逼近次数，不是正文的一阶／二阶对流开关。

For a small, inspectable independent solver, approximate each multiplier with two-dimensional Chebyshev polynomials of total degree at most p. The approximation is differentiable throughout the domain, with no interelement adjoint numerical flux. Mesh cells define the region and quadrature; increasing p adds unknown coefficients, whereas plotting subdivision only improves colouring. The choices p=3,5,7,9 belong to this independent reference, not the main first/second-order convection switch.

λp,c(x,y)=∑k+ℓ≤pcc,kℓTk(x/2)Tℓ(y/2),Ndof=4(p+1)(p+2)2.\lambda_{p,c}(x,y)=\sum_{k+\ell\le p}c_{c,k\ell}T_k(x/2)T_\ell(y/2),\qquad N_{\rm dof}=4\frac{(p+1)(p+2)}2.

程序存储每个局部量的六个数：值、两个一阶导数、三个二阶导数。乘积法则直接给出导数，既不对空间导数取有限差分，也不调用正文的自动微分残差。把基函数逐一代入展开方程，就得到矩形矩阵 MΩM_\Omega；逐一代入入口、牵引出口或壁面条件，得到 MΓM_\Gamma。例如等温壁施加三个伴随值，绝热壁施加两个动量乘子和一个热学法向导数，不能给 α\alpha 任意追加壁值。

Every local quantity carries six numbers: its value, two first derivatives and three second derivatives. Product rules propagate these directly, without spatial finite differences or the main residual’s AD tape. Evaluating each basis function in the expanded PDE forms a rectangular matrix MΩ; evaluating the inlet, traction-outlet or wall conditions forms MΓ. An isothermal wall specifies three adjoint values; an adiabatic wall specifies two momentum multipliers and one thermal normal derivative. Do not add an arbitrary wall value for alpha.

cp=arg⁡min⁡c{∑q∈Ωwq∣(MΩc−b)q∣2+ωb∑q∈Γwq∣(MΓc−d)q∣2},ωb=10.c_p=\arg\min_c\left\{\sum_{q\in\Omega}w_q\left|(M_\Omega c-b)_q\right|^2+\omega_b\sum_{q\in\Gamma}w_q\left|(M_\Gamma c-d)_q\right|^2\right\},\qquad\omega_b=10.

每个多边形先剖成三角形，三角形内用 Duffy 变换和 Gauss 求积，边上用一维 Gauss 求积；边法向始终指向流体外。每向装配点数为 nq=max⁡(4,⌈(p+2)/2⌉)n_q=\max(4,\lceil(p+2)/2\rceil)，验算改用 nq+2n_q+2，防止只在装配点上“看起来精确”。先按列范数缩放矩阵，再采用带列主元的 Householder QR 求超定最小二乘，不构造 MTMM^TM。后者会平方条件数；这里的矩阵也不是正文附录 C 用 LU 求解的离散方阵。缺秩、非正物性或错误的入出流分区必须报错。QR 求出了最小残差系数，并不意味着 PDE 残差已经为零。

Split polygons into triangles and use a Duffy transform with Gaussian volume quadrature, plus Gaussian edge quadrature. Normals always point out of the fluid. Scale columns and solve the overdetermined system using column-pivoted Householder QR, without forming MᵀM, which squares the condition number. This is also distinct from the discrete square LU system in Appendix C. Rank loss, nonpositive transport or an invalid inflow/outflow partition must fail explicitly. Finding least-squares coefficients does not imply zero PDE residual.

For the open inner boundary, define the manufactured objective below, holding every starred or baseline coefficient fixed during parameter variation:

Jm(W)=−∫Ω(LW0∗λ∗)⋅(W−W0) dΩ−∫Γin[v∗⋅(t−t0)+χ∗(qn−qn0)]ds−∫Γouth∗⋅(W−W0) ds.J_m(W)=-\int_\Omega(\mathcal L_{W_0}^*\lambda_*)\cdot(W-W_0)\,d\Omega-\int_{\Gamma_{\rm in}}\left[v_*\cdot(t-t_0)+\chi_*(q_n-q_{n0})\right]ds-\int_{\Gamma_{\rm out}}h_*\cdot(W-W_0)\,ds.

对这个目标求变分，其体内项与边界项恰好给出上面的制造伴随右端。基态不精确时仍固定这些目标系数，不能重新制造目标来强迫误差消失。壁面验证采用同样原则：等温壁加 −β∗⋅(t−t0)−χ∗(qn−qn0)-\beta_*\cdot(t-t_0)-\chi_*(q_n-q_{n0})；绝热壁加 −β∗⋅(t−t0)−(κ∂nχ)∗(T−T0)-\beta_*\cdot(t-t_0)-(\kappa\partial_n\chi)_*(T-T_0)。这些目标是算子与边界的验证工具，不是新的工程优化目标。

Its volume and boundary variations give exactly the manufactured adjoint right-hand sides above. Keep those objective coefficients fixed even when the numerical base is inexact; do not remanufacture the objective to force agreement. Wall verification follows the same construction: add −β*·(t−t₀)−χ*(qn−qn₀) on isothermal walls, or −β*·(t−t₀)−(κ∂nχ)*(T−T₀) on adiabatic walls. These are operator/boundary verification functionals, not proposed engineering objectives.

选取一个同时含 x,yx,y 的方向 VV，建立 Wa=W0+aVW_a=W_0+aV。然后把原始体内源设为 Sa=∇⋅F(Wa)S_a=\nabla\cdot F(W_a)，入口数据取 WaW_a，出口牵引与热流取其物理值。这个族精确满足连续原始问题，但程序在 a=0,±ha=0,\pm h 仍从多项式系数出发求解非线性最小二乘：解析线性化连续通量、QR 求更新、正值检查和回溯。解析族只用于建立右端和独立核验；并不作为数值解返回。更新范数小只说明到达当前空间的驻点，表中另列留出点的原始残差。

Choose a direction V varying in both x and y and define Wₐ=W₀+aV. Set the primal forcing to div F(Wₐ), inlet data to Wₐ, and outlet traction/heat to their physical values. This family solves the continuous primal problem exactly, but the implementation still solves nonlinear least squares in polynomial coefficients at a=0,±h: analytic continuous-flux linearization, QR updates, positivity checks and backtracking. The analytic family defines data and provides a separate check; it is not returned as the numerical solution. A small update means stationarity within the current space; a separate holdout primal residual is reported.
